definitions.assist: last teammate kick before goal-linked shot without opponent or unknown kick
definitions.outcome: goal-linked candidate, followed by another kick candidate, or unknown
definitions.shot: goal-directed kick observed within 5m of goal, excluding likely goal-area passes; goal-linked kicks are included

definitions.body_blocks: candidate count, not confirmed contact or successful block
definitions.kick_bands: stick=weak, bone=medium, blaze rod=strong; based on observed or inferred tool item
definitions.pass_success: next same-ball kick is by a teammate; unknown intervening actors, own next kick and contested sequences are excluded
definitions.possession: short last-kick intervals; contest transitions marked contested; unsupported time remains unknown
definitions.possession_from_tracking: Share of team-controlled tracking intervals among intervals with a known controlling team; contested and unknown intervals are excluded.
definitions.shots: goal-directed candidate with observed ball reaching within 5m of opponent goal, or directly goal-linked; likely passes excluded

possession_from_tracking.definition: Share of team-controlled tracking intervals among intervals with a known controlling team; contested and unknown intervals are excluded.

breakthroughs.definition: candidate when one clearly closest player remains the controller through the window, the ball advances, and tracked defenders ahead decrease in the attack lane

limitations: The timeline estimates team control candidates, not confirmed ball possession.
Distance dominance requires reliable positions for all active players on both teams.
Control outside supported touch and clear-distance intervals remains unknown.
Player control time is attributed only to a player who is clearly closest to the ball.
A foul notification interrupts this timeline as an uncertain stoppage candidate.

possession_summary.definition: Share of team-controlled tracking intervals among intervals with a known controlling team; contested and unknown intervals are excluded.

possession_transitions.definition: loss decisions use the next supported kick on the same ball within the configured gap; intervening unknown-actor kicks are unknown; close rapid opposing touches are contested and missing contest locations stay unknown
possession_transitions.rate_status: candidate counts and observed decisions only; no verified recovery-attempt denominator

limitations: 工程2の表示です。ポゼッション、パス成功率、シュート候補などの試合分析はまだ計算していません。
キック強度と押し付けは観測からの推定で、判定不能なものは不明です。ファウル通知は対象や成功を確定しません。
位置は記録された観測点です。観測の間は画面側で短区間の補間を表示する場合があります。
